task.description:
Validate the requirements drafted by REQ-ANALYST in docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md. The new requirements cover Stages 6.5-11 (OIDC-*, DSL-*, LUA-*, WASM-*, REPO-*, SIM-*), cross-cutting requirements (XC-01..XC-06), and adaptation requirements (ADP-01..ADP-12).

Run these checks against every new requirement:
1. COMPLETENESS: Each requirement has a stable ID, title, description with RFC 2119 language (MUST/SHOULD/MAY), priority field, and at least one acceptance criterion.
2. CONSISTENCY: No requirement contradicts another. Cross-cutting requirements (XC-*) are consistent with stage requirements. ADP-* do not modify existing Stage 1-6 behaviour.
3. ID UNIQUENESS: No duplicate IDs exist in the document. New IDs do not collide with existing Stage 1-6 IDs.
4. TRACEABILITY: Each new requirement can be traced to a specific section of the source addon-1 documents.
5. KEYCLOAK VERSION: No requirement references legacy Keycloak versions or WildFly-based distributions. All Keycloak references must target 26.x / Quarkus-based OSS edition.
6. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA TESTABILITY: Each acceptance hint describes a concrete, observable, testable condition (not vague phrases like "works correctly").
7. NO EXISTING REQUIREMENT MODIFIED: Compare structure of original Stage 1-6 requirements; confirm none were altered.

Produce a PASS or FAIL result. For FAIL, list every issue with: requirement ID, check that failed, and specific description of the problem.

REVALIDATION: REQ-ANALYST has applied rework 1 fixing ISSUE-001..ISSUE-004. Re-run all 7 checks. Focus especially on LUA-03 sandbox list, OIDC-08 acceptance criteria, SIM-10 acceptance criteria, and Appendix A counts.
acceptance_criteria: Every new requirement passes all 7 checks above
Result is PASS or FAIL with a complete issue list
Handoff completed with result.status = PASS or FAIL

result.summary: Re-validation of OIDC-01..OIDC-34, DSL-01..DSL-13, LUA-01..LUA-16, WASM-01..WASM-14, REPO-01..REPO-14, SIM-01..SIM-10, ADP-01..ADP-12 (incl. ADP-04a, ADP-04b), XC-01..XC-06, and IR-01..IR-09. All 4 previously-failed items (ISSUE-001 LUA-03, ISSUE-002 OIDC-08, ISSUE-003 SIM-10, ISSUE-004 Appendix A) are confirmed fixed. All 7 checks pass. No new issues introduced by the rework edits.
result.next_action: Route to DOC-UPDATER (WF-01 Step 3) to set status VALIDATED for all requirement IDs in scope
